node.statement: By node 1.1.2, u_T=Co_T(T), ||Co_T-L_T R_T||<=k*e, and ||XY||<=(1+epsilon)||X||||Y||. Since (L_T R_T)(T)=T(TT) and ||TT-T||<=delta, bilinearity gives T(TT)-T=T(TT-T)+(TT-T). Therefore ||u_T-T||<=||(Co_T-L_T R_T)(T)||+||T(TT)-T||<=k*e*||T||+(1+epsilon)||T||*delta+delta. Using epsilon<=e<=1, delta<=e, and ||T||<=1+a from the preceding child yields ||u_T-T||<=[k*(1+a)+2*(1+a)+1]*e.
